## 🌸 Project Beautiful
**Project Beautiful** is a Minecraft modpack built around one simple goal: making the game look incredible without sacrificing performance. Every mod is chosen to strike the ideal balance between visual enhancement and high framerates, creating a smoother, more beautiful Minecraft experience.

**Latest Release Supports [Minecraft Java 1.21.1](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-1)**

## 🔎 Features

| Feature | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| ✨ Enhanced Visuals | Carefully selected mods/shaders that make Minecraft look more vibrant and immersive. |
| 🚀 Optimized Performance | Built to maintain smooth gameplay and high FPS. |
| 🌅 Shader Ready | Fully compatible with modern shader packs. |
| 🛠️ Quality of Life | Useful improvements without changing vanilla gameplay. |
| ⚖️ Balanced Experience | Every mod is chosen with both beauty and performance in mind. |
| 💻 Wide Hardware Support | Designed to run well on a variety of systems. |

## 🎯 Who Is This For?

Project Beautiful is designed for players who want Minecraft to look significantly better without sacrificing smooth gameplay.

Perfect for:
- Players who want higher visual quality while maintaining high FPS
- Survival and exploration-focused playthroughs
- Shader users looking for a stable foundation
- Mid-range and lower-end PCs that need efficient optimization

## ⚙️ Recommended Settings

For the best experience:

- Allocate 4-6 GB RAM
- Use a Sodium-compatible shader of your choice
- Disable vanilla clouds when using shaders
- Enable all resource packs and/or add your own
- Keep simulation distance at 8-12 chunks for optimal performance

## 📊 Performance Philosophy

Project Beautiful is not a "maximum graphics" modpack.

Every mod is carefully evaluated to ensure that visual improvements justify their performance cost. The goal is to create the most beautiful Minecraft experience possible while maintaining smooth and responsive gameplay.
